params.body:
Five things Shane saw on the worklist page ("Mijn werklijsten") on his phone, on one screen, in one PR. ## Folded on a phone Under 768px every worklist opens folded to its head (title with count) and its one-line description. The title is a button: `aria-expanded` reflects the state, the chevron follows it, the same shape as the header menus of the list pages and the stepper of the vehicle sheet. A tap opens, another tap closes, more than one list may be open, and which ones are open is remembered for the session (`sessionStorage`, every touch in try/catch; when the browser refuses it, everything starts folded). The state lives on the card in `index.blade.php` (`worklistWidget`, registered in `layouts/app.blade.php` because of its size and quotes, X-96); the widget partials are replaced by the pagination AJAX and bind to it again. Desktop folds nothing and looks as before, apart from the counts now also on the first three titles. ## Tables that fit their card All five widgets shared the construction, in two forms: - Leads and transport (`lead-table`) sit in a `.ui-scroll` with a fixed height; `overflow-y: auto` implies a horizontal bar as soon as the table is wider than the half card, and the action column fell out of view. They now get fixed column proportions per table (`ui-leads-table`, `ui-transport-table`), cells may wrap (phone, km and buttons stay on one line), and the scroll box no longer scrolls sideways. - Unfinished vehicles and Car-Pass carry `no-wrap` plus an action cell `fixed_width_module_1|2` whose `min-width` (120/170px) comes from `_index_ownstock.scss` and is for the full vehicle list. With seven columns and three buttons the minimum width exceeded a half card and `overflow: hidden` clipped the edit and delete buttons at 1440px. Inside the widgets the cells may wrap and the min-width is dropped above 768px. On a phone the card form (`ui-cards`) was already on main; what Shane saw was the production of before that. ## One font The release notes are TinyMCE HTML and a note pasted from a word processor carried `font-family: 'Times New Roman'`; the widget renders the stored HTML raw, so the pasted style won. `.ui-note-text` and the detail modal (`.ui-note-detail`, now a `
`: a `

` from TinyMCE closes an outer `

`) force the house font, size, line height and colour on whatever is inside; links keep their colour. Found on the way: `collect($resourceCollection)->toArray()` bypasses `releaseNoteResource`, which is why the widget showed the raw column date; the date now reads d/m/Y. The content itself stays the full HTML (no behaviour change). The editor is not changed tonight; the finding names `paste_as_text` / `valid_styles` as the decision for Shane. How many stored notes carry a pasted font cannot be checked from this machine (no production database here); the finding carries the query. ## Pagination you can tap The bar (`layouts/paginate.blade.php`, shared with offers, orders and the settings lists) is `.d-flex`, and the theme turns `.d-flex` into `display: block` under 768px, so the three parts stacked against the left edge. One rule for every list sharing the bar: under 768px a column with the pages centred on 44px targets and the count under it as a caption. Desktop unchanged. The list pages' markup is untouched; if a `.paginate-balk` rule for those pages lands at the same time, the two should be reconciled. ## The dialog "Weergave werklijsten aanpassen" broke every row into three lines for the same `.d-flex` reason. params.title: The worklists on a phone: folded, tables that fit, one font, pagination you can tap
